title: Filing: Anthropic's IPO could give it an up to $1.405T valuation on a fully diluted basis, up from the $965B valuation during its $65B Series H announced in May (CNBC)
summary: CNBC: Filing: Anthropic's IPO could give it an up to $1.405T valuation on a fully diluted basis, up from the $965B valuation during its $65B Series H announced in May — Anthropic said it will offer 825 million shares in its upcoming IPO at a price range between $70 to $78 per share …
